import java.util.Scanner;

public class Solution {
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
		String s = "";
		try {
			s = in.nextLine();
		} catch (Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		in.close();
		
		System.out.println(analyze(s));
	}
	
	public static int analyze(String s) {
		int insertions = 0;
		int n = s.length();
		int i = 0;
		while (i < n) {
			int j = i;
			char c = s.charAt(i);
			while (j < n && s.charAt(j) == c) {
				j++;
			}
			int size = j - i;
			if (size % 2 == 0) {
				insertions++;
			}
			i = j;
		}
		return insertions;
	}
}
